meta.name: Eric
meta.description: A desperate father, alongside a tenacious cop, battles his own demons on the streets of 1980s New York as he searches for his missing nine-year-old son.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Vincent's son Edgar has an idea for Good Day Sunshine's new puppet. But before he can convince his father, the boy disappears on the way to school.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Vincent's convinced that bringing Eric to life will help his son come home. Detective Ledroit makes an arrest, while Cassie has her own suspicions.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: While Vincent frantically gets ready for the pitch, Ledroit arrives with some more questions for him. Cassie meets the mother of another missing child.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Following shocking news from both Lennie and Cassie, Vincent continues to spiral — until he sees a sign from Edgar and hatches a new plan.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: edroit makes headway in both investigations. Cassie gets a phone call that changes everything, and Vincent continues to follow the map.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As the city's unhoused people are forced onto the street, Vincent meets the one with answers. An old friend helps Ledroit bring buried evidence to light.

meta.slogan: The real monsters aren't under the bed.
